def is_success(s):

def perform_operation(s, k):

    while start > 0 and s[start-1] == coin:
        start -= 1
    end = idx
    while end < len(s) - 1 and s[end+1] == coin:
        end += 1
    block = s[start:end+1]
    remaining = s[:start] + s[end+1:]
    return block + remaining

def check_k(n, k):
